column1: # Edit file for: python ocm\bc_tool.py apply <backup> edits\<file>.tsv
# One edit per line:  parameter = value      (# starts a comment)
# parameter: name as shown by `bc_tool.py show` / the Backup Editor (optionally group/name),
#            or a raw position addr:start:end:mask, e.g. 3221:12:12:11111111b
# value:     hex (05, 0x05), a value label as shown (aktiv, mode Comfort+), or wert_NN
# Example (BDC_BODY3 backup, CAFD 00007083: PfFesMaster byte 12, the Comfort+ drive-mode slot)
